title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior diffuses through a population over time under the influence of peer effects, policies, information campaigns, and supply/price constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe peers' mask use in their social network and update their adoption decision based on thresholds and influence weights.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: Authority issues messages that update individuals' risk perception and perceived benefits of mask use according to their trust and sensitivity.

interactions.name: policy_mandate_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates increase compliance probability; enforcement and penalties further shape behavior, potentially causing adoption or situational compliance.

interactions.name: market_transaction
interactions.description: Persons attempt to acquire masks from retailers; availability and price influence access and adoption decisions.

interactions.name: location_norm_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations set and enforce local norms or requirements that affect on-site compliance and subsequent adoption.

interactions.name: optional_disease_transmission
interactions.description: If disease dynamics are included, person-to-person contacts can transmit infection with probabilities modulated by mask use.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_majority
metrics.description: First time step at which adoption rate reaches or exceeds 50%.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate over the simulation period.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Adoption rate averaged over the final K time steps to gauge persistence.

metrics.name: adoption_by_group
metrics.description: Adoption rates stratified by demographic or socio-economic groups (e.g., age, income).

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_index
metrics.description: Inequality index (e.g., Gini or range) of adoption across groups.

metrics.name: policy_effect_contribution
metrics.description: Estimated marginal contribution of mandates/enforcement to adoption (e.g., via counterfactual comparison).

metrics.name: average_location_compliance
metrics.description: Average fraction of people wearing masks within locations subject to rules.

metrics.name: enforcement_events
metrics.description: Count of enforcement actions taken over time.

metrics.name: masks_sold
metrics.description: Total and time-resolved number of masks sold by retailers.

metrics.name: optional_infection_rate
metrics.description: If disease module is enabled, infection incidence or R_t over time.
